deployments_detail.use: FoxBrain, Foxconn's in-house Traditional Chinese LLM (Llama 3.1-based, trained on NVIDIA H100/Hopper GPUs) for data analysis, decision support, document collaboration, math/reasoning and code generation; deployed for internal manufacturing and operations functions and expanding to EV and smart-city use. [NVIDIA (Hopper GPUs), Meta Llama 3.1]

Nurabot collaborative nursing robot (built with Kawasaki, powered by FoxBrain LLM + NVIDIA Jetson Orin) for medication/specimen delivery, ward patrol and patient guidance; field-trialled and being deployed at Taichung Veterans General Hospital with dozens of units planned. [NVIDIA (Jetson Orin, Isaac), Kawasaki Heavy Industries]
deployments_detail.value: up to 30% reduction in nurse workload

deployments_detail.use: AI factory supercomputer built by Foxconn subsidiary Big Innovation Company with NVIDIA, providing GB300 NVL72 Blackwell compute to Taiwan researchers/industry and powering Foxconn's own smart-manufacturing, EV (ADAS) and smart-city AI workloads. [NVIDIA (10,000 Blackwell GPUs, GB300 NVL72)]

Digital twins of Foxconn's robotic factories (e.g., Guadalajara, Mexico and Houston, Texas plants) built with NVIDIA Omniverse and Siemens Xcelerator/Teamcenter for factory layout simulation, robot training and real-time monitoring. [NVIDIA Omniverse/OpenUSD, Siemens Xcelerator]

DeepHow Live SOP Verification agent deployed in a Foxconn manufacturing center to validate every operator assembly step in real time, detect procedural drift and reduce rework (running on NVIDIA RTX PRO servers, NVIDIA Cosmos). [DeepHow, NVIDIA (Cosmos, RTX PRO Servers)]
deployments_detail.value: first-pass yield improved by 3%; up to 99% task accuracy

deployments_detail.use: CoDoctor AI platform - a coordinated set of specialized medical AI agents (cardiovascular, oncology, retinal imaging, arrhythmia/cancer screening, CoroSegmentater coronary artery segmentation) developed on Hon Hai Super AI Computing Center and deployed across Taiwan medical centers. [NVIDIA (DGX, agentic AI)]

FOXCONN NxVAE - unsupervised deep-learning (variational autoencoder) AI for automated visual defect inspection in manufacturing, requiring only non-defective samples for training. [Foxconn (in-house)]
AI-powered visual quality inspection of smart PV (photovoltaic) controllers using Huawei's Ascend Smart Manufacturing Solution on Foxconn production lines. [Huawei (Ascend)]

Deployment of NVIDIA-powered humanoid robots on the production line of Foxconn's Houston, Texas AI-server (GB300) manufacturing plant, targeting first-quarter 2026 start - the first Foxconn factory to run humanoid robots on the line. [NVIDIA]

Foxconn-Intrinsic (Alphabet) joint venture to integrate Intrinsic's AI robotics platform with Foxconn's Smart Manufacturing platform to build the automated 'AI factory of the future.' [Intrinsic (Alphabet)]
